name: Bloom and glow
one_line: Bright areas bleed soft light into their surroundings, as a lens or the eye does
summary: Highlights spread into a soft halo that falls off across several scales. It makes a source read as emitting light: neon, screens, sparks, sun on chrome. Used on a few chosen elements it gives energy and emphasis; applied to everything it flattens the picture into haze and costs legibility.

routes.one_line: Bloom as an effect pass over a Three.js scene, rendered once per seek

steps.does: Render the lit scene into the buffer the effect pass reads
Spread the highlights with a bloom effect whose strength is set from t

limits: The fixture merges bloom with chromatic aberration and vignette; bloom is not isolated
Determinism is claimed, not how the bloom looks; unseeded noise and glitch effects are excluded

routes.one_line: A ready-made glow or bloom filter on a PixiJS container

steps.does: Draw the 2D scene whose bright elements will glow
Apply a glow or bloom filter to the chosen container, with uniforms set from t

limits: Filter-pack evidence covers the pixelate filter only; glow and bloom filters are untested here
